items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: The interviewee does not mention Dick Allen; Dick Allen is only mentioned by the interviewer as the source of notes.

ctx.x: Well, Ernest Kelly peculiarly enough, he was playing a rather modern style of trombone then. Originally, had they split up? They had split. I came after the split. After the split. Yeah. And he had Jeanette Salvant, she was Salvant then, she was playing piano. And Simon Marrera was playing the bass violin. I took John Marrera's place, the banjo player. And Simon Marrera was playing bass violin. And that's about all. The band, Salistan's band, the men changed for quite a few times and around in the beginning of…

Oh yes. I have some notes here that Dick Allen, who works with me up at the History Department, he evidently copied this out of a book of some kind. Some personnel, and I thought I might check on that, just to be sure it is accurate. This is the band you were talking about, the Buena Vista and Biloxi. Yeah. He has the date given about 1931.
